parts.text: Romazava is a traditional Malagasy stew based on brèdes, leafy greens such as brèdes mafane (anamalaho) and brèdes morelles (anamamy), cooked with meat and spices. The meat is often beef, also zebu, chicken or pork. Brèdes mafane is a main ingredient of the dish, which researchers describe as Madagascar's national dish.
It is often eaten with rice.
